name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.report.crash.CrashActivity
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When the older BigBrother report handler catches an uncaught crash, it opens this screen with the failing page, error stack, and recent session activity.
disableEffect: The older BigBrother crash report screen will be unavailable; the app's normal features are unaffected.
